target.task: Change Site name in ImpressCMS General Settings to Cedar Community Archive, submit Go, and reopen General Settings. Report pass when the saved name matches, fail when a completed valid save gives an internal error or reopens with a different name, or blocked when the check cannot be completed.

preservation.task: Open ImpressCMS Preferences and General Settings. Report pass if the Site name and other settings fields are visible without a PHP error, fail if the page is broken, or blocked if you cannot reach it.
